title: The Cayley-Hamilton theorem and the minimal polynomial in computation
objectives: Prove the Cayley-Hamilton theorem through the adjugate
Compute powers and inverses from annihilating polynomials
Compare the spectra and minimal polynomials of AB and BA
prerequisites: Determinants and adjugates, and Chapters 12 and 13: characteristic and minimal polynomials.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 27 and 28 were read in full; the matrices of the main examples are read out in them, and the divisibility theorem for AB and BA, the field extensions and the exercises are original.
